🫏 New post ready 📖 Story · being kind to yourself · 7 slides “you left the sink full of soapy water and two mugs last night.” 📝 Slides
1. you left the sink full of soapy water and two mugs last night. 2. you usually can't sleep with a dish in the basin and crumbs on the counter. 3. but yesterday at nine, you just turned off the tap and stood there. 4. so you left the sponge in the water and went straight to bed. 5. this morning, the mugs were still soaking by the faucet. 6. but for the first time all week, you woke up before your alarm. 7. the messy sink was just proof that you finally let yesterday end on time.
✍️ Caption
the dishes can sit in the cold water until tomorrow. sleep mattered more than a clean kitchen counter. send this to a best friend who worked late and needs to leave the sink alone tonight. #selflovequotes #bekindtoyourself
